quick_skim.title: Context operations to architecture modelling output from large language models and evaluation criteria for their use in systems engineering design
quick_skim.abstract: The development of generative artificial intelligence resources enables opportunities of speeding up systems and engineering design work. This contribution introduces a framework of formal operations for assembling context in LLM-based engineering design. This framework involves the assembly of modular context units, including policy prompts, reference units with persistence, and user questions with prompt vectoring. This approach enables the systematic structuring of interactions with generative models. A formal method for evaluating modelling-as-code LLM outputs is also presented, which enables the evaluation of compliance to intent from LLM answers and thereby asses the support from LLMs for systems architecture modelling.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This contribution addresses speeding up systems and engineering design with generative AI. It introduces a framework of formal operations for assembling context in LLM-based engineering design, plus a method for evaluating modelling-as-code LLM outputs against design intent.

quick_skim.title: Integrated Population Balance and Multiphysics Modeling for Predicting Undesired Agglomeration in Small Molecule Manufacturing
quick_skim.abstract: Agitated filter dryers (AFDs) are a crucial unit operation in small molecule manufacturing that enables simultaneous filtration, washing, and drying of active pharmaceutical ingredients. One of the key challenges in AFDs is associated with undesired agglomeration, where the presence of hard agglomerates results in off-spec products, equipment damage, and additional downstream processing. This article presents a novel mechanistic model that describes the formation of soft and hard agglomerates during agitated filter drying. By integrating population balance and multiphysics modeling, the model can accurately predict the evolution of the product temperature, moisture content, and particle size distribution, and hence quantify the extend and impact of undesired agglomeration across various operating conditions. Our proposed model-based framework enables the rational design and operation of AFDs for improving the product quality and process reliability.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Agitated filter dryers in small-molecule manufacturing suffer undesired agglomeration that yields off-spec product. The paper builds a mechanistic model coupling population balance and multiphysics to predict temperature, moisture and particle-size evolution during filter drying.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 搅拌过滤干燥器是小分子原料药生产中集过滤、洗涤、干燥于一体的关键单元操作，但易产生硬团聚导致产品不合格与设备损坏。本文构建耦合群体平衡与多物理场的机理模型，描述软硬团聚的形成过程，可预测产物温度、含水率与粒径分布的演化。结果表明该模型能较准确地刻画团聚行为，为该分离单元的设计与操作优化提供依据。
